From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>

Cc: FinanceOps <financeops@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly forecast submission: velocity check + final slate

Team —

Quick reminder for this week's submit window. Please do the following before EOD Wednesday (09/06):

- Update stage for any deals with activity in the last 14 days (move to Commit/Best Case/At-Risk as appropriate).
- Add ARR delta and primary close reason in the spreadsheet for each moved deal.
- Flag any deals needing escalation in the "ops_notes" column.

Attached: 2028-Q3-pipeline-velocity.xlsx (master copy). I've pre-filled accounts we discussed on Friday. If you don't own an account listed as "unassigned" please claim it in the sheet and add your initials.

Call: 09/06 10:30-10:50 PT (15 min lightning slate + 5 min Q/A). Join: short review of top 12 deals only. Agenda below.

Agenda (10/06 call)
- 10:30 Opening & velocity snapshot — me (2m)
- 10:32 Top 8 deal rollcall — each owner (1m each)
- 10:42 Escalation flags & quick decisions (6m)
- 10:48 Commit reconciliation and final asks (2m)

Ask from me: if you cannot finish the updates, post a one-line status in the sheet and tag me. I'll escalate after 11:00 PT.

Thanks —
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2028-Q3-pipeline-velocity.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
